description: A table-type recordset over G with Index PK_G: PercentPosition and ID at every row from MoveFirst to the last by MoveNext; then, on fresh recordsets with the index set, each value 0, 2.5, ..., 100 assigned and PercentPosition and ID read. Decides the scale and the assignment under an index (r-cursor-1b/percent-table-pages: 99.12281 at the last of 228 rows). The fixture copy is opened read-only.
